build_all_estimators: build a list of all scikit-learn estimator classes inheriting from BaseEstimator
filter_estimators_by_type: filter scikit-learn estimators by type such as classifier, regressor, transformer, or cluster
get_classifiers: get all scikit-learn classifier estimators using all_estimators with type_filter classifier
get_displays: get all scikit-learn display classes ending with Display from the sklearn package
get_all_functions: get all public scikit-learn functions from the sklearn package excluding private ones
